detail.longDescription: I'm currently trying to get https://github.com/cs01/pyxterm.js working on Windows, I got it working on Linux but whenever I try Windows, I run into the issue that the `termios` module is not found. It also uses "pty" and "fcntl" which I believe only work on Unix/Linux as well. Are there any drop-in replacement-like modules I could install, like if I could do this?: try: import termios except ImportError: import termios-windows as termios I searched related questions already and all they said was that termios is only for Linux and that I'll have to use WSL or something else I have to install but I'm just looking for a pure Python way to do this where I don't have to mess with anything else outside my comfort zone.
